claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Yamaha-branded black electronic keyboard/synth, but do not show it powering on, sound output, or full functionality; no evidence about suitability for children beyond the general type.
Brand text appears at the bottom-left in Photo 2.

risks.risk: Unknown exact model and feature set (e.g., number of keys, built-in sounds, MIDI/USB) which affects value
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number label (usually on the back panel or underside) and the control panel showing ports/inputs.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for an older/entry-level Yamaha keyboard with unknown features.

risks.risk: Not confirmed working: keys, speakers, buttons/sliders, and sound output may be faulty
risks.proof: A short video clip of powering on and playing several keys, plus testing at least: volume knob, a few buttons/sliders, and speaker output (audible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully working/untested until a power-on and sound test is shown.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged accessories (power adapter/cord, sustain pedal, stand, cables) can make it unusable or reduce value
risks.proof: Photos showing included items laid out (adapter/cord, sustain pedal, any cables/stand) and a shot of the keyboard’s power input/battery compartment if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming the most important accessory (power adapter/cord) may be missing.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues (key wear, scratches/dents, missing knobs/buttons, repairs) not fully verifiable from the current angles
risks.proof: Straight-on close-ups of the full keybed (top and front edges), both ends, and the control panel showing every knob/button/slider; include any visible damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for cosmetic wear/possible missing parts not shown clearly.

risks.risk: Serial number/production year and warranty status unknown; affects collectability and reliability expectations
risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial number/production label (back/underside) and any warranty/receipt documentation if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as older/unknown production year with no warranty.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model number/name label (back or underside) so the exact Yamaha model is identifiable.
Short video: power on + audible sound test (play keys across the range) and demonstrate volume plus at least 3–5 buttons/sliders.
Photo/video showing all included accessories (power adapter/cord, sustain pedal, stand/cables) and a shot of the keyboard’s power input/battery compartment.
Close-up photos of the entire keybed and control panel to confirm no missing/damaged knobs/buttons/sliders and to assess wear.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Yamaha keyboard, but the exact model and working condition (power-on, sound, and controls) are not verifiable from the photos. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
